name: Needle in a haystack, 32k
description: The six 32k single-needle items of eval-longctx-v1 (three depths, two seeds each). Answers whether the model can still retrieve a fact from a 32k-token document, and what that costs in time to first token.

eval.notes: Retrieval accuracy is reported in scores.accuracy alongside the serving metrics; report it per depth in scores.by_category where possible.

notes: Select the eval-longctx-v1 rows whose meta.target_tokens equals 32768 and whose category is 'needle'.
